commands:
set -euo pipefail
BASE=5a29da82ce7be901caef14e8d9f0c13e32fa4943
HEAD_SHA=dfab4f776cd5091a6ee3f5fbf25d35f52c5a95e2
BRANCH=work/photomap-straighten-20260912
APP=frontend/src/styles/app.css
GUIDES=frontend/src/pages/GuidesPage.tsx
PLACE=frontend/src/pages/PlaceDetailPage.tsx
cleanup() { git restore --worktree -- "$APP" "$GUIDES" "$PLACE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; ./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$HEAD_SHA"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HEAD_SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
cd frontend
npm run build >/tmp/photomap-content-css-after.log
AFTER_GZIP=$(python3 -c 'import glob,gzip; p=glob.glob("dist/assets/index-*.css"); assert len(p)==1,p; print(len(gzip.compress(open(p[0],"rb").read(),mtime=0)))')
AFTER_RAW=$(python3 -c 'import glob; p=glob.glob("dist/assets/index-*.css"); assert len(p)==1,p; print(len(open(p[0],"rb").read()))')
echo "after_css_assets=$(find dist/assets -maxdepth 1 -name '*.css' -print | sort | tr '\n' ' ')"
cd ..
git show "$BASE:$APP" > "$APP"
git show "$BASE:$GUIDES" > "$GUIDES"
git show "$BASE:$PLACE" > "$PLACE"
cd frontend
npm run build >/tmp/photomap-content-css-baseline.log
BASE_GZIP=$(python3 -c 'import glob,gzip; p=glob.glob("dist/assets/index-*.css"); assert len(p)==1,p; print(len(gzip.compress(open(p[0],"rb").read(),mtime=0)))')
BASE_RAW=$(python3 -c 'import glob; p=glob.glob("dist/assets/index-*.css"); assert len(p)==1,p; print(len(open(p[0],"rb").read()))')
cd ..
git restore --worktree -- "$APP" "$GUIDES" "$PLACE"
SAVED=$((BASE_GZIP-AFTER_GZIP))
echo "baseline_index_css_raw=$BASE_RAW"
echo "after_index_css_raw=$AFTER_RAW"
echo "baseline_index_css_gzip=$BASE_GZIP"
echo "after_index_css_gzip=$AFTER_GZIP"
echo "saved_index_css_gzip=$SAVED"
test "$SAVED" -ge 1500
cd frontend
npm run lint
npm run build
cd ..
VENV=/tmp/photomap-content-css-101-venv
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd frontend
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- e2e/visual/guides.spec.ts e2e/visual/places.spec.ts --project=chromium
cd ..
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
trap - EXIT
./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
